reviews.body:
Request changes — one fix, then ready to ship: give the attachment-bearing create request a client timeout longer than 60s.

Must fix:

1. api/pkg/cli/spectask/task_cmd.go:44 — create with inline `--attach` reuses `taskRequest`'s 60s `http.Client` timeout while the server allows 10 min ingestion on a detached context (`types.SpecTaskInlineAttachmentIngestionTimeout`, spec_driven_task_handlers.go:152): when the CLI times out mid-upload the server still finishes, creates and publishes the task, the CLI prints "failed to create task", and a user retry duplicates the task. The old post-create upload path used a no-timeout client, so this is a new ceiling exactly for the large-attachment case this PR enables. Fix: minutes.

```go
timeout := 60 * time.Second
if len(request.Attachments) > 0 {
    timeout = types.SpecTaskInlineAttachmentIngestionTimeout + time.Minute
}
// taskRequestWithTimeout: same as taskRequest but takes the http.Client timeout
```

Also:
- api/pkg/cli/spectask/task_cmd.go:430 — no client-side size pre-check: a >100MB file is buffered 3x (raw + base64 + JSON marshal) before the server 413s; check `len(data)` against `types.SpecTaskAttachmentMaxBytes` and the running total against `types.SpecTaskInlineAttachmentsMaxBytes` before building the request. Effort: minutes.
- Same-basename files from different dirs now fail create with 400 "duplicate attachment filename" — the old multipart upload path accepted them; pre-check in the CLI and report both full paths. Effort: minutes.
- api/pkg/cli/spectask/spectask_test.go:173 — new test covers only the happy path; add a `--attach` missing-file case asserting no HTTP request is sent. Effort: minutes.

Verified: `go vet` + `go test ./api/pkg/cli/spectask/... -count=1` pass on 10df30c7 (new inline-attachment test asserts exactly one POST and the base64 payload).
Verified: server side agrees — `go test ./api/pkg/server/ -run 'TestSpecTaskInline|TestCreateTaskFromPrompt'` pass, incl. publish-only-after-attachments-persist; repo has no PR CI (stainless only), so these runs are the verification.

Reviewed: 10df30c7179155b244fd2201ac5480af309176d2

Approve — ready to ship; all four round-1 findings are fixed in 10df30c7..2dc89c96, merge when ready.

Round-1 findings, verified fixed at 2dc89c96:
- 60s client timeout vs 10-min server ingestion — fixed: `createRequestTimeout` gives attachment-bearing creates ingestion+1min (api/pkg/cli/spectask/task_cmd.go:40, applied at :456), exactly the prescribed fix; asserted by `TestCreateRequestTimeoutOutlivesIngestion` (spectask_test.go:221).
- No client-side size pre-check — fixed: `buildInlineAttachments` (task_cmd.go:915) rejects per-file and running-total overruns before any buffering, limits match the server constants (`SpecTaskAttachmentMaxBytes` / `SpecTaskInlineAttachmentsMaxBytes`), with a post-read total re-check covering the stat-vs-read race.
- Same-basename collision — fixed: rejected up front with both full paths (task_cmd.go:923); the server's inline validation 400s the same case, so CLI and server agree.
- Missing-file test asserting no HTTP request — added: `TestCreateWithAttachRejectsBadFilesWithoutRequest` (spectask_test.go:230) asserts zero HTTP hits for the missing-file and same-basename cases, plus `TestBuildInlineAttachmentsRejectsOversizeFile` (spectask_test.go:271) truncates to max+1 and expects rejection.

Must fix: none.

Also:
- api/pkg/cli/spectask/task_cmd.go:930 — a stat failure (e.g. parent-dir permissions) reports "failed to read --attach"; say "stat" so the error isn't misread. Effort: minutes.
- api/pkg/cli/spectask/task_cmd.go:933 — limit errors print raw byte counts; a `(~%d MB)` alongside reads better at 100MB scale. Effort: minutes.

Verified: `go vet ./pkg/cli/spectask/...` and `go test ./pkg/cli/spectask/... -count=1` pass on 2dc89c96 — all tests incl. the 3 new ones, and the new tests assert the actual behavior (zero HTTP hits on bad `--attach`, timeout strictly greater than the server ingestion window, oversize rejection).
Verified: CLI limits match the server contract (100MB per file / 100MB total / request cap = base64+4MB, publish-only-after-attachments-persist); repo has no PR CI (Drone triggers push/tag only), so these local runs are the verification.

Reviewed: 2dc89c96efa88c2988e6802f2cffdfcc4f3b4649

comments.body:
Pushed 2dc89c9: create with `--attach` now uses a client timeout of ingestion timeout + 1 min (`createRequestTimeout`); the CLI pre-checks per-file and total size against `SpecTaskAttachmentMaxBytes`/`SpecTaskInlineAttachmentsMaxBytes` before reading the files; same-basename files fail fast naming both paths; tests added for the missing-file and same-basename cases (assert no HTTP request) plus the timeout and oversize checks.


This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
